name: Obsidian
license: Free (closed source); notes are plain Markdown files you own
summary: Fast notes app that stores everything as plain text files on your computer.
gains: Your notes are plain files: no lock-in, ever
tradeoffs: Official sync is paid (free options: Syncthing or iCloud folder)
setupSteps: Create a vault (a folder on your computer)
Use the official Importer plugin to bring in your Notion export
Optional: sync the vault folder with Syncthing for free
commercialNote: Closed-source app, free for personal and commercial use. Your notes are plain Markdown files you fully own.
